scope: Only arcified/docs/native-space-consumer-inventory.md and evidence under arcified/docs/research/native-space-consumers/. Source/document checks only.

retrieval.command: sha256sum on every captured source file

packageScripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test

formatting.scope: Root and arcified config/instructions; repository config-name search to depth 4 found only arcified/extension/package.json. No Markdown tool installed.

documentation.whitespaceExitMeaning: Status 1 with no diagnostics means new-file differences; no whitespace errors were emitted.
documentation.jsonParsing: Parsed source manifest, feature catalog, all retrieval metadata, all shallow tree JSON, tag, local inputs, search ledger at creation, and the two persisted failure records. No JSON syntax errors.

coverageLimits.enabledConfiguration: No generated GN/buildflag or runtime FeatureList snapshot. Header declarations are completely enumerated; implementation/caller closure is not complete.
coverageLimits.globalSearch: No Chromium-wide index or caller search. Only explicitly captured source files and selected local patch-header patterns.
coverageLimits.platforms: Source paths inspected for Linux, Windows and macOS; no installed behavior or platform acceptance checked.
coverageLimits.nativeRuntime: None. No prepared source tree, compilation, native browser interaction, actual window identity trace, storage separation or exact page transfer/recovery test.
coverageLimits.policies: Safety signals, cleanup, destructive actions and populated migration/source disposition remain OPEN.
